en.title: Welcome to Wonderland Gonline
en.change_later: You can change the language later in Settings.
en.missing: Game assets are missing or could not be loaded.
en.installation: Select your Wonderland Online Rhodes Island installation folder.
en.originals_safe: Choose the folder containing aLogin.exe and data. Originals are kept unchanged.
en.path_hint: Click Browse or type/paste the installation path here
en.dependencies: Extraction requires Python 3.11+, Pillow, FFmpeg and FFprobe on PATH.
en.duration: Extraction can take several minutes and requires several GB of free disk space.
en.no_restart: Click Start client to continue. No restart is required.
en.choose_source: Select or enter the Rhodes Island installation folder first.
en.picker_error: Folder picker unavailable. Type or paste the installation path instead.
en.cancelling: Cancelling safely; waiting for the current extraction/build step to finish...

zh-TW.title: 歡迎使用 Wonderland Gonline
zh-TW.change_later: 您可以稍後在設定中變更顯示語言。
zh-TW.missing: 找不到遊戲資源，或無法載入資源。
zh-TW.installation: 請選擇飄流幻境羅德島傳的安裝資料夾。
zh-TW.originals_safe: 請選擇包含 aLogin.exe 和 data 的資料夾。原始檔案不會被修改。
zh-TW.path_hint: 按瀏覽，或在此輸入／貼上安裝路徑
zh-TW.dependencies: 需要 Python 3.11+、Pillow，以及 PATH 中的 FFmpeg 和 FFprobe。
zh-TW.duration: 擷取可能需要數分鐘，並需要數 GB 的可用磁碟空間。
zh-TW.no_restart: 按啟動客戶端即可繼續，無需重新啟動。
zh-TW.choose_source: 請先選擇或輸入羅德島傳的安裝資料夾。
zh-TW.picker_error: 無法開啟資料夾選擇器，請直接輸入或貼上安裝路徑。
zh-TW.cancelling: 正在安全取消，請等待目前的擷取或編譯步驟完成...
